CANON — KOREAN FACES on every person, named or extra: living eyes with WHITE sclera, a small catchlight, and BLACK ink-black iris and pupil (never brown, hazel, amber, honey, gold, blue, grey, green or purple). Never paint the entire eyeball solid black. A low soft Korean nasal bridge, never a high European, Roman or Persian nose. East Asian bone: single-lidded or low-creased eyes, straight or softly arched brows, broad cheekbones, flatter facial planes, warm ivory to sun-browned skin, straight coarse black hair. Never Western, Latin, or mixed-race features, never deep-set double-lidded western eyes. | DANGUN — FACE and garments from attached /ch_dangun.png (face only; invent a new pose). #b8956a as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. | SOBYUL — FACE and garments from attached /ch_little_star.png (face only; invent a new pose). Look: Three ages, all painted webtoon, never a photograph. YOUNG, before the wager (attached /ch_little_star_young.png): black hair, two red feathers, white robe with red slashes, a red bow. GROWN, lord of the living (attached /ch_little_star.png): black hair, a small smile, white silk with red shoulder marks, black and red cuffs, hands clasped. OLD, at the Three Realms (attached /ch_little_star_old.png): silver hair, one red feather still in it, moustache, same white robe with red marks. Dress: White silk with red marks and a dark sash. The red bow belongs to the years before the wager. Demeanor: Quick, a little petty, excuses that almost land as apologies. #C94040 as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: jougwan; black underworld silk; cloned onto Big Star; sage-green gardener clothes. | DAEBYUL — FACE and garments from attached /ch_big_star.png (face only; invent a new pose). Look: Three ages, all painted webtoon, never a photograph. YOUNG, before the wager (attached /ch_big_star_young.png): black hair, two blue feathers in the topknot, white robe, blue sash, a bow. GROWN, lord of the dead (attached /ch_big_star.png): long black hair, faint smile, black silk, ice-blue sash and trim, hands clasped. OLD, at the Three Realms (attached /ch_big_star_old.png): silver hair in a tail, grey moustache and short beard, same black silk and blue sash, stern and still. Dress: Black silk po with ice-blue collar, sash and cuffs, cream inner once he takes the dead. Before the wager the robe is white with a blue sash. Demeanor: Magnanimous, judicial, quiet. Settles a matter in one sentence. #3B6FBF as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: jougwan; a petty smile; cloned onto Little Star; sage-green gardener clothes. | HALLAKGUNGI — FACE and garments from attached /ch_gardener.png (face only; invent a new pose). Look: Always young — a Peter Pan boy, late teens at most: oval Korean face, black eyes, a sly closed-mouth smile, black hair in a small topknot under a black cloth headband with loose strands at the temples. Drawn webtoon, never photoreal, never his father’s closed-eye grin. Dress: Sage-green po over a white inner collar, dark teal sash and inner, one sleeve of red wildflowers, a brown strap. Attached /ch_gardener.png. The west-road journey is before the basket: plain undyed white hemp that frays, no flowers. Revenge disguise: gray hood, fake gray beard, a gray cloth blindfold over ONE eye (the other eye stays his), peeled at the unveil. Demeanor: Whimsical, cheeky, unhurried. Jokes at the other gods. Exact about flowers. Under the revenge hood: gentle smile while the house laughs, cries, and bleeds. #8FBF8A as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: photoreal K-drama face; ageing into his father; his father’s closed-eye grin or /ch_sara.png; jougwan; body glow aura. | COSTUME CHARTS (attached): cut, collar, sleeve, sash, trouser and skirt shapes of every Samhan figure follow the chart for their kingdom; it is a style chart, so ignore its labels, captions, maps, poses and faces. Named people keep their portrait face and colours; extras and soldiers dress like the chart (a commoner like its commoners, an official like its officials, a soldier like its soldiers). COMMONERS in every Samhan kingdom wear SIMPLE WHITE: plain undyed white or off-white hemp and ramie jackets, wide trousers and skirts, a cloth sash, straw sandals or bare feet, hair in a plain topknot or braid — no dyed silk, no dots, no gold; colour belongs to rank, so a crowd of farmers, porters, servants and townsfolk reads as a field of soft white cloth with the officials' colours standing out of it. Gojoseon: attached /ref_hanbok_gojoseon.png.
